text: 1) Application Form for Admission to Peking University Preparatory Students. After successful online registration, submit and print the application form, sign it, and post a photo;2) Original high school graduation certificate or pre-graduation certificate (study certificate), if the original is not in Chinese or English, the original notarized Chinese or English translation must be submitted;3) Original full transcript of senior high school. If the original is not in Chinese or English, the original notarized copy with Chinese or English translation shall be submitted;4) Personal Statement (please click to download template: Personal Statement, please fill in Chinese or English);5) 2 letters of recommendation, one of which must be from the teacher or class teacher of the applicant's high school, and the other can be selected by the referee, no rank requirement;6) Passport copy, must hold a regular passport valid later than July 2024;7) Application letter of commitment (please click to download template: Letter of commitment, please fill in Chinese or English);8) Non-mandatory materials: including but not limited to SAT/IB/A-Level/ACT transcripts, national college entrance examination transcripts, award certificates, HSK transcripts, other language proficiency certificates and other materials that are considered helpful to the application (photocopies are sufficient).
